description: Magical Deckbuilder is organized as a decoupled MVVM application where the WPF Presentation Layer communicates with an Application Controller (MVVM) that orchestrates interactions with core shared game logic. The primary flow is: user actions in the UI are handled via ViewModels in the Application Controller, which then update or query core systems — Game Mechanics Core for turn and character logic, Card & Deck System for creating/managing cards and decks, the Card Crafting Engine for combining cards, and the AI Strategy Module for opponent decisions — with updated state propagated back to the UI via data binding.

components.name: Presentation Layer
components.description: Handles the visual rendering of the game and user interactions via WPF Views and custom Controls.

components.name: Application Controller (MVVM)
components.description: The central hub of the UI application, managing state, commands, and data flow between the UI and core logic.

components.name: Game Mechanics Core
components.description: Defines the fundamental rules and entities of the game, including characters, health, and turn-based logic.

components.name: Card & Deck System
components.description: Manages the lifecycle of cards and decks, including creation, shuffling, and drawing mechanics.

components.name: Card Crafting Engine
components.description: Specialized logic for the card combination system, allowing players to merge cards into new variants.

components.name: AI Strategy Module
components.description: Provides automated decision-making for the opponent, including move selection and difficulty-based deck building.

components_relations.relation: Binds UI elements to ViewModel properties and executes user commands.
Updates character health/mana and manages turn transitions.
Manages player hand state and deck initialization via the CardFactory.
Triggers the combination of selected cards into new custom cards.
Requests opponent move calculations and difficulty-based deck generation.
Utilizes DeckManagers to track character resources and in-play cards.
Evaluates card values for move selection and populates opponent decks.
